text:
Kris Jenner dead at the age of 67. Her daughters Kourtney, Kimberly, Khloé, Kendall and Kylie have confirmed the death. The cause of death is still unknown. Kris was found in her home in Hidden Hills, CA December 23, 2022 at 8:56am when boyfriend, Corey Gamble, made the 911 call. Gamble tells news reporters she was unconscious and that he could not hear her breathing nor could feel her pulse. She was taken to Pediatric Urgent Care and was later pronounced dead at 9:41. Kimberly (Kim) states “I don’t know what i’m going to do without her, I love her so much”
